 Chig Okonkwo Week 10 Outlook - Commanders at Giants 
 By Derek Brown (FantasyPros) , Thu, Nov 12th 2026, 1:35pm EST 
 Since Week 7, Chig Okonkwo has been the TE25 in fantasy points per game, with one outing with double-digit PPR points. He has had a 17.2% target share with 1.51 YPRR, one red zone target, and an 18.8% first-read share. Sit Okonkwo this week. Over their last five games, New York has allowed the third-fewest yards per target and the sixth-fewest fantasy points per opportunity to tight ends.
